body.title: Test fixtures: record builders and real-shape records
body.summary: Create src/workflow/delivery/__tests__/fixtures.ts with builders that fabricate ArtifactRecords and record sets per kind (in the style of pending.test.ts's pendingLld) and with real-shape fixtures copied by value from the 2026-10-07 store: the S001/s001 pair in epic dfc0371b, ISSUE-0855311b6b32eb72, ISSUE-2d9e9e694a94116b, ISSUE-57446545909fe95c, ISSUE-095906bac5bbacaf, LLD-d88062a6e63aa312-s1 with its BUILD, BUILD-d5a433047dc3439f-s1 with its CR, BUILD-0855311b6b32eb72-s1, one flat AMD and one EXT.
acceptanceChecks: Fixtures are plain values in the test tree; no test reads the live .insrc/artifacts store.
Each real-shape fixture keeps the fields the LLD's edge cases rely on (standalone, epicCreatedAt, parentRef, storyId, body.tasks ids).

tests.name: fixtures.test.ts: 'every real-shape fixture builds a valid ArtifactRecord with its identity fields intact'
